exceptions.rationale: DCloud 3.0.0-5010520260709002 declares an exact Vite 5.2.8 peer while the patched advisory requires Vite 6.4.3 or later; Full.NET has verified Vite 5.4.21 without claiming upstream support.
mitigations: The uni-app development server binds only to 127.0.0.1.
Client directories must not contain secrets, .env files, certificates, or private keys.
Production artifacts do not include the Vite development server or its Node runtime package; only generated build helper identifiers may remain.

exceptions.rationale: The patched brace-expansion 5.x API is incompatible with minimatch 9.x, which declares brace-expansion ^2.0.1. The vulnerable package is confined to the pinned vue-tsc development toolchain, so a cross-major override would break fresh installs.
mitigations: The dependency executes only during repository-controlled type checking and is not shipped in client production artifacts.
Type-check inputs and glob patterns come from version-controlled workspace configuration rather than remote user input.
The exact dependency path is pinned and must be re-reviewed when vue-tsc or @vue/language-core is upgraded.
